weighting.restriction: The phase and core fractions are not validated final owner-core inclusion probabilities (P3-3, W46.marks-sampling-support): report core results descriptively, A-core and B-core apart, as an enriched set; no population recall, mixed share or corpus-weighted routing benefit is weighted from them. The independent mixed share and interval are mixed-def-score's; within-core paired route comparisons stand.

scope: Descriptive enriched core, A-core/B-core apart. No population weights or prevalence. Feedback pages are not detector training/evaluation truth; rough draft boxes are not independently measured geometry. Non-core agreement remains model drafts, never truth.
image_provenance: Sheet images are EXIF-upright copies downscaled to at most 2400 pixels and saved at JPEG quality 95, not original JPEG bytes. Source inventory and original hashes are retained in scan-provenance; feedback about legibility is unresolved.
